skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.

skills.name: diagnosing-superpowers
skills.description: Use when a superpowers session went wrong and your human partner wants to know why — repeated work, ignored plans, stumbles, poor results, a skill that didn't fire, "it took too long", "why is it so expensive", "what is it doing" — or wants to build a bug report for the superpowers maintainers, for the current session or a past one identified by id or path, on any harness.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.description: Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work
headings: Capture now, while still inside the workspace — Step 5 changes directory
Get main repo root for CWD safety
Merge first — verify success before removing anything
From a detached HEAD, name the new branch on the remote:
If your human partner asks to discard the work

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
headings: Red Flags - STOP and Follow Process
your human partner's Signals You're Doing It Wrong

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
headings: Red Flags - STOP and Start Over

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback
headings: If this returns a path, you're in a submodule, not a worktree — treat as normal repo
Determine path based on chosen location

skills.name: using-superpowers
skills.description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

skills.name: writing-skills
skills.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment

headings: Run with explicit timeout for CI environments
